note: Which country belongs to which of the five regional indices. Read out of the Country/Market Breakdown of the five factsheets (see scripts/indices.py), not decided here. scripts/check_sources.py compares this file against the freshly downloaded factsheets and fails if it has drifted - so it cannot go stale unnoticed. FTSE Japan has no country table because a single-country index has nothing to break down; its entry comes from the registry. Countries of the All-World that are in none of the five are not listed and are shown as their own slice in the app: Israel is developed but sits in FTSE's Middle East & Africa region.
